data.name: Holiday Inn Express Tuxtla Gutierrez la Marimba by IHG
data.address: Av Central Pte 1254, Col. Centro, El Magueyito, 29000 Tuxtla Gutiérrez, Chis., Mexico
data.description:
Among city shops and businesses, this unpretentious hotel is a 4-minute walk from Parque de la Marimba and 2 km from Faustino Miranda Botanical Garden.
The casual, down-to-earth rooms and suites include flat-screen TVs and free Wi-Fi, as well as tea and coffeemaking facilities. Suites add kitchenettes, dining rooms and pull-out sofas.
Complimentary amenities include parking, and a breakfast buffet offered in a laid-back dining room. There’s also a bar and a gym.
